title: Software design documentation package (project-approval grade)
description: Different in kind from EPIC-1 through EPIC-8, which build code — this epic builds the formal design-documentation package a project-approval / architecture-review process needs: system architecture, data architecture, API/interface specification, sequence and flow diagrams, security design, data governance and compliance, extensibility architecture, non-functional/performance/capacity design, deployment and operations, testing strategy, and a risk register. Hard rule for every story: no competitor or reference-implementation names anywhere in this package (unlike every prior epic, which cites Oracle AI Agent Memory / Mem0 / Azure Cosmos DB's Agent Memory Toolkit / Microsoft Agent Framework by name as research grounding) — every document describes this system purely on its own technical merits, sourced only from this repository's own code, DECISIONS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and BENCHMARKS.md. Naming LangChain/OpenAI Agents SDK/MCP/Microsoft Agent Framework as integration targets this SDK ships adapters for remains fine (a technical dependency, not a competitive comparison) — citing any of them as design inspiration is not. New documents live under a new project-management/design/ directory, not folded into ARCHITECTURE.md, which stays the single living current-state summary per its own closing section. See the dated 2026-08-02 'EPIC-9 backlog' DECISIONS.md entry for the full rationale. Designed for maximum parallelism: SDD-1 through SDD-11 are fully independent — each authors exactly one new file, reads existing code/docs only, and writes nothing any other SDD-* story writes — safe to run as eleven simultaneous subagents. SDD-12 (the package index) depends on all eleven and must run last.
